gaps.lead: He was elected, and he broke his first promise immediately.
gaps.sentence: ___ than he broke his first promise.
gaps.explanation: Passive inversion: No sooner had he been elected than…

gaps.lead: They say the new tunnel will halve journey times.
gaps.sentence: Journey times ___ by the new tunnel.
gaps.explanation: X is said to be + participle: reported statement, passive meaning.

gaps.lead: I'd love to be lying on a beach right now.
gaps.sentence: I ___ lying on a beach right now.
gaps.explanation: wish + past subjunctive: I wish I were (formal 'were', not 'was').

gaps.lead: 'We are closing the factory,' the board announced.
gaps.sentence: The board announced that ___ the factory.
gaps.explanation: we → they; present continuous → past continuous: they were closing.

gaps.lead: The film we saw last week was better than this one.
gaps.sentence: This film is not ___ the one we saw last week.
gaps.explanation: 'Not as good as' expresses an inferior comparison.

gaps.lead: You'll fail your exam if you don't revise.
gaps.explanation: unless + present simple = if you don't.
